title: Prime Minister condoles the loss of lives in mishap in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan
subtitle: PM announces ex-gratia from PMNRF
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has condoled the loss of lives due to a mishap in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. The Prime Minister announced an ex-gratia from PMNRF of Rs. 2 lakh to the next of kin of each deceased and Rs. 50,000 for those injured. The Prime Minister posted on X: Saddened by the loss of lives due to a mishap in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. My condolences to the bereaved families. May the injured recover at the earliest. An ex-gratia of Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF would be given to the next of kin of each of those who lost their lives. The injured would be given Rs. 50,000: PM @narendramodi Saddened by the loss of lives due to a mishap in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. My condolences to the bereaved families.
